repos.name: 01-terraform-multi-az-vpc
repos.title: Multi-AZ Three-Tier VPC Module
repos.summary: Terraform module for a three-tier AWS VPC across two or three availability zones, with NAT, VPC endpoints and flow logs.
repos.problem: Hand-built VPCs drift: databases get default routes, an AZ ends up without NAT, and S3 traffic pays NAT data charges.
repos.safety: Input validation rejects bad CIDR sizes, environments, AZ counts and NAT strategies, and isolated subnets have no default route.
repos.tested: terraform test plans against a mocked AWS provider, with fmt, validate, tflint and Checkov in CI.
repos.limits: Tests are plan-only with a mocked provider; nothing has been applied to an AWS account.

repos.name: 02-ansible-linux-hardening
repos.title: CIS-Subset Linux Hardening Roles
repos.summary: Ansible roles that harden Ubuntu 24.04 and RHEL 9 web hosts with SSH lockdown, fail2ban, automatic security updates and network settings.
repos.problem: Stock images allow password SSH and legacy ciphers, and hardening by hand drifts between servers.
repos.safety: sshd config is checked with sshd -t before any restart, disabling password login first checks for an authorized key, and rollout runs in 25% batches.
repos.tested: yamllint, ansible-lint, a syntax check, and Molecule converge, idempotence and verify on Ubuntu 24.04 and Rocky 9 containers in CI.
repos.limits: Never run against a real EC2 host; the sudo path and real nftables banning are not exercised.

repos.name: 03-python-ebs-orphan-report
repos.title: Orphaned EBS Volume Report
repos.summary: Python tool that scans every account and region in an AWS Organization for unattached EBS volumes and writes the old ones to a CSV with an estimated cost.
repos.problem: Unattached EBS volumes keep costing money, and across many accounts and regions nobody sees them all in one place.
repos.safety: It never deletes anything; a person reviews the CSV.
repos.tested: pytest with moto only.
repos.limits: Not run against a live AWS organization, and volume age comes from CreateTime, not detach time.

repos.name: 04-terraform-cross-account-ci-role
repos.title: Cross-Account CI IAM Role
repos.summary: Terraform module that creates one IAM role a single CI role from another account can assume, with an external ID, a one-hour session and only the listed actions.
repos.problem: CI should not hold long-lived access keys for other accounts.
repos.safety: Wildcard actions (* and service:*) are rejected, and no policy is attached until resource ARNs are set.
repos.tested: terraform test against a mocked AWS provider checks the exact CI role in the trust policy, the external ID, wildcard rejection and the one-hour session.
repos.limits: Never applied to a real account; partial wildcards such as s3:Get* are allowed and there is no permission boundary.

repos.name: 05-bash-ebs-snapshot-retention
repos.title: EBS Snapshot Retention Script
repos.summary: Bash script that snapshots EBS volumes tagged Backup=true and prunes only the snapshots it created once they pass a retention period.
repos.problem: Backups that nobody runs, and snapshot sprawl that nobody cleans up.
repos.safety: prune is a dry run unless --execute is passed, only touches snapshots tagged created-by=ebs-backup-script, and refuses retention under 7 days without a flag.
repos.tested: shellcheck and a test script that runs the tool against a fake aws CLI on PATH.
repos.limits: Never run against a real AWS account; no cross-region copy and no restore check.

repos.name: 06-github-actions-image-pipeline
repos.title: Container Image Build, Scan and Sign
repos.summary: GitHub Actions pipeline that builds a container image, scans it with Trivy, and on main pushes a multi-arch image to GHCR and signs it with Cosign.
repos.problem: Unscanned images reach production, unsigned images can't be traced to their pipeline, and pushing from every branch leaks unreviewed images.
repos.safety: The scan fails on fixable HIGH or CRITICAL findings, and push and signing run only on main.
repos.tested: The scan, multi-arch push and signing passed in GitHub Actions on main, and a script checks that the workflow keeps its gates.
repos.limits: The pushed image is a separate build from the scanned amd64 image, and the arm64 image is not scanned.

repos.name: 07-semver-tag-action
repos.title: Semantic Version Tag Action
repos.summary: Reusable GitHub Action that reads conventional commits since the last stable tag, picks the next version, tags the commit and creates a release with notes.
repos.problem: Manual version bumps drift, changelogs get skipped, and tags stop matching what shipped.
repos.safety: A dry-run input prints the next version and notes without tagging, pushing or releasing.
repos.tested: shellcheck and a test script that builds throwaway git repos, mostly in dry-run mode.
repos.limits: Not yet run as an action in GitHub Actions, and pre-release tags are not supported.

repos.name: 08-terraform-plan-policy-check
repos.title: Terraform Plan Policy Check
repos.summary: Dependency-free Python script that checks a Terraform plan JSON for public S3 buckets, missing Owner and CostCenter tags and disallowed instance types, and exits 1 on any violation.
repos.problem: Policy-breaking Terraform plans are usually found after apply, and manual plan review doesn't scale.
repos.tested: unittest with hand-written plan fixtures (six tests).
repos.limits: Not run against a real Terraform plan; only planned values are checked, not provider defaults.

repos.name: 09-argocd-applicationset-kustomize
repos.title: Argo CD ApplicationSet with Kustomize
repos.summary: One Argo CD ApplicationSet that renders a shared Kustomize base into dev, stage and prod Applications; dev and stage auto-sync, prod syncs manually.
repos.problem: Hand-copied per-environment configs drift apart, and promoting to prod becomes a manual, error-prone sync.
repos.safety: Prod syncs manually, and workloads run non-root with a read-only root filesystem and no Linux capabilities.
repos.tested: yamllint, kustomize build, kubeconform, a rendered-output test and a non-root nginx -t check in CI.
repos.limits: Not applied to any Argo CD instance, and cluster URLs are placeholders.

repos.name: 10-terraform-drift-detection
repos.title: Scheduled Terraform Drift Detection
repos.summary: Scheduled GitHub Actions workflow that runs terraform plan with detailed exit codes, counts drifted resources from the plan JSON and can post a summary to Slack.
repos.problem: Changes made outside Terraform go unnoticed until someone runs plan or something breaks.
repos.tested: shellcheck and a test script that applies terraform_data configs in temp folders and checks no drift, drift counts, replacement, errors and the Slack message.
repos.limits: Drift is only simulated with terraform_data; real cloud drift and a real Slack post are not tested.

repos.name: 11-helm-12factor-chart
repos.title: 12-Factor App Helm Chart
repos.summary: Helm chart for a stateless 12-factor web app with HPA, PodDisruptionBudget, NetworkPolicy and ExternalSecret, with values checked by a schema.
repos.problem: Hand-deployed services drift, get no autoscaling, and lose capacity during node drains.
repos.safety: Pods run non-root with a read-only root filesystem, no privilege escalation and no Linux capabilities.
repos.tested: helm lint, helm template for default and prod values, kubeconform, and a rendered-output test.
repos.limits: Not deployed to any cluster; HPA, PDB and NetworkPolicy are only checked in rendered YAML.

repos.name: 12-k8s-configmap-secret-controller
repos.title: ConfigMap-to-Secret Sync Controller
repos.summary: Python Kubernetes controller that watches annotated ConfigMaps and keeps a matching Secret in step with a value in AWS Secrets Manager.
repos.problem: Copying secrets into Kubernetes by hand leaks them into terminals and chat logs, and the copies go stale when the value rotates.
repos.safety: It never overwrites a Secret it did not create, and never logs secret values.
repos.tested: unittest with a fake secret store and a fake Kubernetes API.
repos.limits: Not run against a real cluster or AWS; it watches one namespace and picks up rotation by polling.

repos.name: 13-python-pod-security-audit
repos.title: Pod Security Audit CLI
repos.summary: Read-only Python CLI that audits Kubernetes manifests for privileged containers, hostPath volumes and missing resource limits, and prints a Markdown or JSON report.
repos.problem: Privileged containers, hostPath mounts and missing limits are easy to miss in review.
repos.safety: Read-only, including the optional live-cluster mode, which only lists pods.
repos.tested: unittest against example manifests and inline YAML, with no cluster.
repos.limits: Only three rules, and the live-cluster mode has never been run against a real cluster.

repos.name: 14-helm-observability-sidecar-library
repos.title: Observability Sidecar Helm Library
repos.summary: Helm library chart that defines a StatsD-to-Prometheus exporter sidecar, a Fluent Bit sidecar and restricted security contexts for any chart to include.
repos.problem: Sidecars added by hand differ in every chart, with different images and missing security settings.
repos.safety: Security contexts default to non-root, no capabilities, no privilege escalation, a read-only root filesystem and RuntimeDefault seccomp.
repos.tested: helm lint, helm template with and without sidecars, kubeconform -strict, and a rendered-output test.
repos.limits: Never deployed, and no end-to-end metrics pipeline is exercised.

repos.name: 15-python-networkpolicy-generator
repos.title: NetworkPolicy Generator
repos.summary: Python CLI that turns a short YAML intent file into one Kubernetes NetworkPolicy per service, with optional default-deny policies.
repos.problem: Hand-written NetworkPolicies are long, easy to get subtly wrong and hard to review.
repos.safety: It never talks to a cluster, and a service named in no rule gets a policy that denies all traffic.
repos.tested: unittest on valid and invalid intent files, cross-namespace rules, default-deny and the output-directory path.
repos.limits: No ipBlock peers, DNS egress must be allowed explicitly, and the policies were never applied to a cluster.

repos.name: 16-lambda-iam-mfa-enforcement
repos.title: IAM MFA Enforcement Lambda
repos.summary: Python Lambda that reacts to IAM CreateUser events, attaches a deny-without-MFA policy to the new user and publishes an SNS notification.
repos.problem: A new IAM user without MFA is one leaked credential away from full use of its permissions.
repos.safety: The attached policy only denies actions when MFA is absent and still allows self-enrolment.
repos.tested: unittest with mocked IAM, SNS and STS clients.
repos.limits: Not deployed and no live AWS calls; existing users are not covered.

repos.name: 17-ansible-ssh-key-rotation
repos.title: SSH Key Rotation Role
repos.summary: Ansible role that rotates SSH host keys and authorized_keys across a fleet, records each host in a central JSON inventory and can notify owners by webhook.
repos.problem: SSH keys that never change and authorized_keys files that only grow leave old access in place.
repos.safety: Check mode with --diff gives a dry run, host key checking stays on, and webhook notifications are off by default.
repos.tested: yamllint, ansible-lint, a syntax check, pytest on the filter plugin, and the notification tasks run against a local HTTP server.
repos.limits: Never run against a real fleet, and two failure paths are untested.

repos.name: 18-terraform-s3-public-remediation
repos.title: Public S3 Bucket Auto-Remediation
repos.summary: Terraform module that uses AWS Config to flag public S3 buckets and can turn on Block Public Access through an SSM Automation remediation.
repos.problem: A bucket made public by a policy or ACL change can expose data before anyone notices.
repos.safety: Detect-only by default; remediation needs automatic_remediation = true, and its role can only read and set Block Public Access.
repos.tested: terraform fmt, validate and test with a mocked AWS provider, plus tflint and a Trivy config scan in CI.
repos.limits: No live deployment; Config evaluation and the remediation have not run in a real account.

repos.name: 19-python-securityhub-jira-aggregator
repos.title: Security Hub to Jira Aggregator
repos.summary: Python CLI that ranks Security Hub findings by severity and asset criticality and opens one Jira ticket per finding above a priority bar.
repos.problem: Hundreds of findings with the same severity mean very different things on different assets.
repos.safety: Dry run by default; real Jira calls need --execute, and findings that already have a ticket are skipped.
repos.tested: unittest against example exports and an in-memory fake Jira client.
repos.limits: Reads an exported findings file only, and --execute against real Jira is untested.

repos.name: 20-precommit-secret-scan
repos.title: Pre-Commit Secret Scanner
repos.summary: Pre-commit hook and CI check using detect-secrets 1.5.0 to block hard-coded credentials, plus a small custom regex and entropy scanner.
repos.problem: A credential that reaches a commit has to be revoked and scrubbed from history.
repos.safety: A new unbaselined secret blocks the commit, and baselines and allow comments are treated as security-sensitive changes.
repos.tested: unittest, including installing the hook into a temporary consumer repository, plus pre-commit run --all-files in CI.
repos.limits: A heuristic guard only; it does not prove a repository has no secrets.

repos.name: 21-terraform-prometheus-grafana-stack
repos.title: Prometheus and Grafana Stack Module
repos.summary: Terraform module that installs kube-prometheus-stack with node and pod health alerts and two starter Grafana dashboards.
repos.problem: Monitoring stacks installed by hand end up with different chart versions, different alerts and secrets in values files.
repos.safety: The webhook URL and admin password stay in existing Kubernetes Secrets; Terraform only gets their names.
repos.tested: terraform test with mock providers, promtool check and test rules, and jq on the dashboard JSON.
repos.limits: Never applied against a real cluster, and dashboards are only checked as valid JSON.

repos.name: 22-python-metric-anomaly-alerts
repos.title: CloudWatch Metric Anomaly Alerts
repos.summary: Python CLI that pulls CloudWatch metrics, flags anomalies with a rolling z-score and posts a Slack alert with the expected range and a recommended action.
repos.problem: Fixed thresholds either fire constantly or miss problems on metrics whose normal level moves.
repos.safety: --dry-run prints the Slack payload without posting, and the webhook URL is never printed.
repos.tested: unittest with hand-written fakes for the detector, CloudWatch pagination, Slack posting and the CLI.
repos.limits: Never run against real CloudWatch or Slack, and repeated alerts are not de-duplicated.

repos.name: 23-fluentbit-k8s-log-routing
repos.title: Fluent Bit Kubernetes Log Routing
repos.summary: Fluent Bit config and DaemonSet that enrich container logs with Kubernetes metadata and route them to Elasticsearch, S3 or Splunk by pod label.
repos.problem: One team's logs need to go somewhere different from another's without running separate DaemonSets.
repos.safety: Unlabelled records and unknown label values go to a default output instead of being dropped.
repos.tested: fluent-bit --dry-run, a fixture-based routing test through the real engine in Docker, and kubeconform -strict.
repos.limits: Never run against a real cluster or backend, and the live Kubernetes metadata lookup is not exercised.

repos.name: 24-python-slo-burnrate-metrics
repos.title: SLO Burn-Rate Metrics Service
repos.summary: Python order simulator that exposes Prometheus latency and outcome metrics and ships a multi-window SLO burn-rate alert.
repos.problem: Alerting on raw error rates either pages for every blip or reacts too late to a slow leak.
repos.tested: unittest for the burn-rate math and /metrics output, and promtool test rules for a firing and a non-firing case.
repos.limits: Never run against real traffic or a real Prometheus server.

repos.name: 25-ansible-datadog-agent-rollout
repos.title: Datadog Agent Rollout Role
repos.summary: Ansible role that installs and configures the Datadog agent on Debian, RedHat and Windows hosts, with tags and optional APM.
repos.problem: Agents installed by hand end up with missing tags, mixed settings and hosts that never report.
repos.safety: The play fails if the API key is unset or the APM flag is not a boolean.
repos.tested: yamllint, ansible-lint, a syntax check per OS family, check-mode config runs and negative tests in Linux CI.
repos.limits: Never run against a real host or Datadog account, and the Windows install path is only syntax-checked.

repos.name: 26-bash-asg-bluegreen-deploy
repos.title: ASG Blue/Green and Canary Deploys
repos.summary: Bash framework for blue/green deploys of two EC2 Auto Scaling Groups behind one target group, with a canary step and a health gate.
repos.problem: Replacing a fleet in place lets a bad release reach every instance before anyone sees it fail.
repos.safety: Dry run is the default and makes no AWS calls, and a failed canary or full-capacity check rolls back before blue is touched.
repos.tested: shellcheck and a test runner against a fake aws CLI that records every call.
repos.limits: Never run against a real AWS account, ASG or target group.

repos.name: 27-python-cloud-tagging-cli
repos.title: Cloud Resource Tagging CLI
repos.summary: Python CLI that reports AWS resource tags that break a YAML policy and fixes the ones it can, with Azure and GCP as interface stubs.
repos.problem: Resources get tagged inconsistently across clouds and over time.
repos.safety: apply writes nothing without --apply and never guesses a missing or disallowed value.
repos.tested: 29 pytest tests with a fake boto3 client, including the CLI end to end.
repos.limits: Never run against a real AWS account; Azure and GCP are stubs.

repos.name: 28-lambda-unused-resource-cleanup
repos.title: Unused AWS Resource Cleanup
repos.summary: Two Lambdas: one finds unused Elastic IPs, old AMIs, unused security groups and idle load balancers, the other deletes only human-approved items after a re-check.
repos.problem: Unused resources keep costing money, but deleting them automatically is risky.
repos.safety: Cleanup is a dry run unless APPLY is set, re-checks every item before deleting, and IAM denies deletes on protect-tagged resources.
repos.tested: pytest with hand-written boto3 fakes, including re-check pagination and the IAM policy structure.
repos.limits: Never deployed or run against AWS, and the AMI check ignores launch templates.

repos.name: 29-azure-resource-group-module
repos.title: Azure Resource Group Module
repos.summary: PowerShell module that creates Azure resource groups with a fixed naming convention, a delete lock and a monthly budget in one idempotent call.
repos.problem: Resource groups created ad hoc get inconsistent names, no delete protection and no cost visibility.
repos.safety: Every step supports -WhatIf, and lookups fail loudly instead of guessing.
repos.tested: Pester with mocked Az cmdlets, and PSScriptAnalyzer.
repos.limits: Never run against a real Azure subscription.

repos.name: 30-python-dynamic-ansible-inventory
repos.title: Dynamic Ansible Inventory
repos.summary: Python script that implements Ansible's dynamic inventory contract for AWS EC2, grouping running instances by provider and tag.
repos.problem: A static inventory file goes stale as soon as instances are replaced.
repos.safety: Read-only, and it never prints a partial inventory when a provider fails.
repos.tested: pytest with a fake EC2 client, plus ansible-inventory over a fixture script in CI.
repos.limits: Never run against a real cloud account; Azure and GCP are stubs.

repos.name: 31-python-cost-explorer-report
repos.title: Weekly AWS Cost Report
repos.summary: Python script that reads two weeks of Cost Explorer data and writes a Markdown report of the top cost drivers by service and by one tag.
repos.problem: The Cost Explorer console shows what was spent, but not what changed this week or who owns it.
repos.tested: 32 pytest tests with a fake client and JSON fixtures, including error and empty-data cases.
repos.limits: Not run against a real AWS account; Azure and PDF output are not implemented.

repos.name: 32-lambda-scheduled-instance-stop
repos.title: Scheduled Non-Production Instance Stop
repos.summary: Lambda that stops opted-in non-production EC2 and RDS instances outside the business hours set in their tags, with a temporary override tag.
repos.problem: Non-production instances left running at night and at weekends are paid for while nobody uses them.
repos.safety: DRY_RUN defaults to true, and only opted-in, non-production resources are touched.
repos.tested: 47 pytest tests with fake EC2 and RDS clients.
repos.limits: Not deployed, it only stops instances, and RDS starts itself again after 7 days.

repos.name: 33-terraform-mandatory-tag-policy
repos.title: Mandatory Tag Policy Module
repos.summary: Terraform S3 module that refuses to plan unless its cost-allocation tags are present, lowercase and well formed.
repos.problem: Untagged resources can't be charged back to a team, so cost reports end up with a large unknown line.
repos.safety: Variable validation and resource preconditions fail the plan before anything is created.
repos.tested: 14 terraform test runs against a mocked AWS provider, 12 of them expected failures.
repos.limits: Only covers resources created through this module, and nothing has been planned or applied in AWS.

repos.name: 34-python-vm-rightsizing-advisor
repos.title: EC2 Rightsizing Advisor
repos.summary: Read-only Python tool that compares two weeks of EC2 CPU and memory use with a YAML catalog and suggests one size down, one size up or no change.
repos.problem: Instances are sized by a guess at launch and rarely looked at again.
repos.safety: Read-only; it never changes anything.
repos.tested: 34 pytest tests with fake EC2 and CloudWatch clients.
repos.limits: Not run against a real account, and it only moves one size within a family.

repos.name: 35-python-s3-lifecycle-savings-report
repos.title: S3 Tiering Savings Report
repos.summary: Read-only Python job that estimates monthly savings from Intelligent-Tiering or a Standard-IA lifecycle rule and writes a Markdown report.
repos.problem: Objects in S3 Standard that nobody reads are still billed at the Standard rate.
repos.safety: Read-only, and all prices are labelled as placeholders.
repos.tested: 29 pytest tests with a CSV fixture and a fake ListObjectsV2 client.
repos.limits: Not run against a real account, and savings are an upper bound based on object age, not access.

repos.name: 36-terraform-transit-gateway-hub-spoke
repos.title: Transit Gateway Hub with Inspection
repos.summary: Terraform module for a Transit Gateway hub that sends all spoke-to-spoke traffic through AWS Network Firewall in an inspection VPC.
repos.problem: With many VPCs, flat routing lets any VPC reach any other with no check in between.
repos.safety: Default TGW route tables are disabled, and the plan fails if the firewall has no endpoint in the chosen AZ.
repos.tested: 10 terraform test runs against a mocked AWS provider, including spoke isolation and a missing-endpoint failure.
repos.limits: Nothing has been planned or applied in AWS, and the firewall endpoint is in a single AZ.

repos.name: 37-python-security-group-audit
repos.title: Security Group Audit
repos.summary: Read-only Python script that reads security groups across accounts and regions, writes a CSV of every ingress rule, and reports rules open to the internet and unused groups.
repos.problem: Rules open to the whole internet are easy to miss across many accounts.
repos.safety: Read-only, and no reports are written if any account or region fails.
repos.tested: 28 pytest tests with fake EC2 and STS clients.
repos.limits: Not run against real accounts, and Azure NSGs are not implemented.

repos.name: 38-ansible-ipsec-vpn-tunnels
repos.title: IPsec Tunnels with strongSwan
repos.summary: Ansible playbook and role that set up an IKEv2 IPsec tunnel between two strongSwan gateways with X.509 certificates and a health check timer.
repos.problem: Tunnels set up by hand with a shared key are hard to repeat, hard to rotate and can fail without anyone noticing.
repos.safety: Real runs start with --check --diff, private keys come from Ansible Vault, and a test checks that no key or certificate is in git.
repos.tested: yamllint, ansible-lint, a syntax check, shellcheck and 19 pytest tests, including the health check against a fake swanctl.
repos.limits: No tunnel has been brought up, and the role has never run against a real host.

repos.name: 39-python-gitops-dns-reconciler
repos.title: GitOps DNS Reconciler
repos.summary: Python tool that keeps Route 53 records in line with a YAML file in Git, prints a plan and applies it as one change batch only when asked.
repos.problem: DNS changes made in the console have no review or history, and a wrong record can take a service offline.
repos.safety: Plan only by default; NS and SOA records are protected and a deletion guard can refuse a plan.
repos.tested: 32 pytest tests with a fake Route 53 client that pages like the real API and applies batches all or nothing.
repos.limits: Not run against a real hosted zone, and Azure DNS is a stub.

repos.name: 40-terraform-private-api-gateway
repos.title: Private API Gateway Pattern
repos.summary: Terraform module that exposes an internal service through a private REST API, an execute-api VPC endpoint, a VPC link and an internal NLB.
repos.problem: Internal services often get a public API endpoint by default and rely on auth alone.
repos.safety: A policy guard fails the plan without an endpoint-scoped Deny, the endpoint policy allows only this API, and allowed CIDRs must be private.
repos.tested: 14 terraform test runs against a mocked AWS provider, including bad policies fed to the guard.
repos.limits: Nothing has been planned or applied in AWS, and there is no auth beyond the network path.

repos.name: 41-python-rds-failover-test
repos.title: Cross-Region RDS Failover Test
repos.summary: Python script that promotes an RDS cross-region read replica, checks the application can connect, times it and writes a Markdown report.
repos.problem: A disaster recovery plan that has never been run is a guess.
repos.safety: Dry run by default, and the IAM policy allows promotion only on instances tagged environment=staging or dr-test.
repos.tested: 20 pytest tests with fake RDS and CloudWatch clients, an injected clock and a fake connectivity check.
repos.limits: Nothing has promoted a real database, and Azure SQL is not implemented.

repos.name: 42-terraform-lambda-cross-region-backup
repos.title: Cross-Region EBS Backup
repos.summary: Terraform module and Lambda that copy the latest snapshot of tagged EBS volumes to a second region with a KMS key in that region, and prune old copies.
repos.problem: Snapshots that only exist in the volume's own region don't help during a regional outage.
repos.safety: The function is a dry run by default.
repos.tested: 20 pytest tests with fake EC2 clients and 6 terraform test runs against mocked providers.
repos.limits: Nothing has been planned or applied in AWS, and the function has never run against real snapshots.

repos.name: 43-terraform-multiregion-ha-pattern
repos.title: Multi-Region Active-Passive Pattern
repos.summary: Terraform module for a DynamoDB global table replicated to a second region and Route 53 failover records driven by a health check.
repos.problem: Running in one region means a regional outage takes the application down with it.
repos.tested: 6 terraform test runs against a mocked AWS provider, and the example validates against a committed lock file.
repos.limits: Nothing has been planned or applied in AWS, so replication lag and real failover are untested.

repos.name: 44-python-chaos-engineering-fis
repos.title: Chaos Runner for AWS FIS
repos.summary: Python script that runs AWS FIS experiments one at a time and checks that the system recovers within the time limit its runbook gives.
repos.problem: Runbooks say systems recover on their own, but that is rarely checked before a real failure.
repos.safety: Dry run by default; injecting needs --execute and guards can refuse an experiment.
repos.tested: 27 pytest tests with a fake FIS client, an injected clock and a fake steady-state check.
repos.limits: Nothing has started a real FIS experiment, and Azure Chaos Studio is not implemented.

repos.name: 45-lambda-ecs-autoremediation
repos.title: ECS Auto-Remediation Lambda
repos.summary: Lambda that forces a new deployment when an ECS task crashes and scales out by one task when targets are unhealthy, for opted-in services only.
repos.problem: Crashed tasks and unhealthy targets need the same first fix, at any hour.
repos.safety: Dry run by default, only services tagged auto-remediate=true, a cooldown, and a hard maximum on scale-out.
repos.tested: 30 pytest tests with fake ECS and ELBv2 clients and a fixed clock.
repos.limits: Not deployed, and it has never called real ECS or ELB APIs.

repos.name: 46-gitops-crossplane-monorepo
repos.title: GitOps Monorepo with Crossplane
repos.summary: One repository that Argo CD watches to manage both cloud infrastructure through Crossplane and an application through Kustomize, from a single root Application.
repos.problem: Infrastructure and applications in separate tools are reviewed in two places and drift in two ways.
repos.tested: kustomize build and kubeconform -strict against checksum-verified schemas, with five negative cases that must be rejected.
repos.limits: Nothing has been applied to a cluster, and credentials and the Argo CD installation are not built.

repos.name: 47-python-opa-compliance-engine
repos.title: OPA Compliance Engine
repos.summary: Six Rego rules, a YAML mapping to SOC 2 and ISO 27001 control IDs, and a Python runner that reports pass, fail or not evaluated per control.
repos.problem: Compliance evidence is often collected by hand, from screenshots, once a year.
repos.tested: 14 opa test cases and 16 pytest tests that call the real pinned opa binary.
repos.limits: The control mapping is illustrative, not an audit, and there is no live cloud collection.

repos.name: 48-fastapi-temp-access-portal
repos.title: Temporary Access Portal
repos.summary: FastAPI backend where developers request time-limited access to an allowlisted IAM role, another person approves, and the STS credentials expire on their own.
repos.problem: Standing admin access is easy to misuse and hard to review.
repos.safety: Requesters can't approve their own requests, approvers can be limited per role, and sessions end with the approval window.
repos.tested: 30 pytest tests through FastAPI's TestClient with a fake granter and an injected clock, including concurrent requests.
repos.limits: No authentication is built, and it runs as a single process with requests in memory.

repos.name: 49-python-cmdb-sync-tool
repos.title: AWS Config to CMDB Sync
repos.summary: Python tool that syncs AWS Config inventory into a SQLite CMDB, soft-retiring missing resources and reviving ones that come back.
repos.problem: A CMDB filled in by hand goes out of date quickly, so nobody trusts it during an incident.
repos.safety: A dry run prints the diff without writing, and it refuses to retire everything when the source returns nothing.
repos.tested: 20 pytest tests with a fake Config client and temporary SQLite files.
repos.limits: Nothing has called AWS, and it covers one account and region per run.

repos.name: 50-golden-path-env-provisioner
repos.title: Golden Path Environment Provisioner
repos.summary: Reusable GitHub Actions workflow that validates one parameter file and provisions a VPC, EKS, observability and a sample app with Terraform and Ansible.
repos.problem: When every team builds its own environment, each one ends up different and takes weeks.
repos.safety: Apply needs approval on a protected environment, plan uses a read-only role, and only one run per environment can run at a time.
repos.tested: 34 pytest tests, actionlint, terraform validate, ansible-lint, a syntax check and check mode in CI.
repos.limits: Never planned, applied or run against a cluster.
